nodes.label: Statistical Integrity Dashboard (Visual Diagnostics)
nodes.rationale: QQ-Plot for Heavy Tail detection, ACF chart for volatility persistence, Convergence Plot for sample adequacy. Validates Gaussian/non-Gaussian assumptions in ILI and signal models.

nodes.label: MarketEfficiencyMonitor (Fundamental-Algorithmic Gap)
nodes.rationale: Visualizes drift between fundamental ILI value and algorithmic high-frequency volume imbalance. Flags periods where price discovery is driven by AT noise vs. fundamental macro events.

nodes.label: Monetary Policy Sensitivity Panel
nodes.rationale: Dashboard panel showing Fed balance sheet trends, key policy rates, and yield curve shape as macro regime signals. Data ingested from FRED central bank balance sheet data.
